## **The ingenious goal to exploit resources in a once beautiful land.**
**theJ00k's Technica** is an experimental kitchen-sink modpack that focuses on tech-based mods and completing the game as fast as possible.

It avoids big world generation mods and keeps the terrain strictly vanilla as possible so you can bring in your own seeds that worked in vanilla without any world generation nonsense ruining it. Although, you might see some new structures in your world.

## DISCLAIMER FOR LIVESTREAMING
This modpack utilizes music taken from commercial albums and other video games.

If you are planning on livestreaming, click the "Toggle Music" button on the credits screen found on the main menu.
